question: Why does PortfolioRiskAdmission still report PENDING_RISK_UNVERIFIED for entry orders that the remote-status audit has proven to hold no active risk?
method: Read-only: durable rows from runtime_entities(kind='entryOrders'), runtime_events payloads, and the two production predicates. No DB write, no settings change, no order action.

theTwoStillOccupying.why: the row's own activeRiskExposure flag is still true, so the canonical predicate keeps it as risk even though release evidence exists. Conservative direction.
release evidence passed validUntil; the periodic remote audit re-verifies it (nextRemoteAuditAt is scheduled), so this row is correctly kept as unproven right now.

noUnknownWasTurnedIntoZero: Confirmed: every release decision in this cross-check is taken from the row's own durable activeRiskEvidence (status VERIFIED_NO_ACTIVE_RISK + identityTombstone match + validUntil in the future), never from an assumption. Rows without currently valid evidence stay counted.

rootCause.authoritativePredicateItShouldReuse: apps/engine/src/services/entryRiskOccupancy.ts:23 entryOrderOccupiesRisk(order, now), which for status UNKNOWN returns !hasVerifiedNoActiveRisk(order, now) (entryRiskOccupancy.ts:10)
rootCause.mechanism: Two independent accounts read the same rows. The occupancy account (slots, capacity.used, symbol exclusion, candidate lifecycle) consults hasVerifiedNoActiveRisk, so an UNKNOWN row with authoritative no-active-risk evidence stops occupying. The risk ledger's builtPending instead re-implements a status-only filter and adds a missing-or-future expiresAt test; every one of these 46 rows has expiresAt = null, so !row.expiresAt is permanently true and the rows are counted forever.
rootCause.secondConsequence: buildPortfolioRiskSnapshot pushes each pending row into exposures and sums grossNotionalUsd/longNotionalUsd/shortNotionalUsd/capitalAtRiskUsd over all of them, so the 44 released rows contribute about $30.6k of phantom notional to the risk account, roughly 3x the live equity of ~$10.6k.
rootCause.safetyDirection: Over-counting, never under-counting. No real risk is released by this defect, which is why it is not a P0. It is a P1 for the next milestone: once a profile is configured, STRESS_LIMIT:MAX_GROSS_NOTIONAL and the direction limits will bind against phantom exposure, so approving a portfolio risk profile alone will not produce entries.

minimalFixForTheNextRound.change: In portfolioRiskLedger.inputs(), derive builtPending from the canonical predicate: keep reservations as they are, and take entry orders with [...state.entryOrders.values()].filter(row => entryOrderOccupiesRisk(row, now)) instead of the inline status/expiry filter.
minimalFixForTheNextRound.mustNotDo: Do not clear UNKNOWN to a terminal status, do not rewrite the UNKNOWN row (entryRiskOccupancy.ts documents that the row itself is never rewritten), do not shorten the evidence TTL, and do not add a second pending account.
hostileTestsRequired: UNKNOWN row with currently valid VERIFIED_NO_ACTIVE_RISK evidence and matching tombstone contributes neither a PENDING_RISK_UNVERIFIED blocker nor pending notional
UNKNOWN row whose evidence has expired still blocks and still counts
UNKNOWN row with activeRiskExposure true still blocks
row with an actual exchangeOrderId or filledQuantity > 0 still blocks regardless of evidence
gross/direction/cluster sums drop exactly the released rows' notional and nothing else

answerToSection5Item10: A product patch IS required before a configured PortfolioRisk profile can be expected to admit entries. Ordering: fix the pending projection (offline, red to green), then the operator approves profile values, then executionMode may be discussed.
evidence: pending-risk-crosscheck.json (per-row status, exchangeOrderId, filledQuantity, expiresAt, intentId, reservationId, durable evidence and latest remote audit)
